summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage ships install-time dropper that downloads Bun and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then runs the shipped `math_init.js` under that freshly-downloaded interpreter via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with a shuffled constant string array and a rotator function (`WV8StW`), so the executed code is opaque to inspection. Delivering the payload through a second runtime is an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-focused scanners. The package name closely mimics the legitimate `@verdaccio/local-storage` plugin (the description literally states "Cropped and fixed version of the @verdaccio/local-storage plugin"), and the `repository` field points at `github.com/servicetitan/uikit`, an unrelated org; the `dist/` tree looks like the real plugin and functions as a decoy around the added preinstall dropper. The verdaccio storage plugin's stated purpose does not require the Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
